decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting serves a specialist niche with long procurement cycles, so its value is still unresolved, it costs little to keep listed, and it fits the firm's robust specialist lighting focus.

The general interior luminaire is a second-generation core product that is still listed, but it moved from its own page to a mention, which suggests it is becoming a routine catalogue item rather than one that has shown it lacks value.
The microprismatic pendant is a flagship that was still promoted as a latest release in 2024, and it matches the firm's direction, so the option is worth keeping open and investing in further.

The marine searchlight line remains listed, but its sibling HMI searchlight was already dropped, which raises the risk of pruning; still, its listing costs little and its niche value is not yet disproven, so keeping the option is justified.
